acceptance_criteria.text: Local test controls are absent by default and startup rejects enabling them when the service is not loopback-bound or any provider credential is configured.
The opt-in local surface resets to checked-in synthetic scenarios, sets virtual time, and executes a bounded number of market fixture events without network access.
The local state inspection returns normalized market and account snapshots, positions, open orders, exposure, and replay cursor.
The local trace endpoint exposes bounded request/control records with virtual timestamps and route templates, excluding query strings and request bodies.
